finding_key: packages/slides/src/export/pdf.ts::group elements with an absent (or non-array-children) `data` still pass the walk and are stored, crashing every consumer that dereferences `el.data.children`
evidence: Verified against the supplied controller source: assertValidElementData (docs-content.controller.ts) repairs an absent `data` only for `e.type === 'text'`; a group element with absent data hits the generic `if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;` un-repaired, and a non-array `data.children` is silently skipped by `Array.isArray(data.children) ? data.children : []` — both shapes pass validation and are stored verbatim by writeSlidesRoot. packages/slides/src/export/pdf.ts's flattenElements dereferences `el.data.children` unconditionally (`if (el.type === 'group') walk(el.data.children)`), and the controller's own comments confirm migrateElement repairs shapes only, so nothing fixes it on read. This is the same TypeError-for-every-viewer failure the PR classed as blocking for text `data` and table-cell `body`, left reachable for groups.
